claim: Factors which drive and control disease progression can be inferred from mathematical models that integrate measures of immune responses, data from tissue sampling and markers of infection dynamics.
source: The factors which drive and control disease progression can be inferred from mathematical models that integrate measures of immune responses, data from tissue sampling and markers of infection dynamics.
evidence: This is a methodological assertion about the capability of mathematical models to infer disease progression factors, presented as a general statement without specific supporting data or citations in the abstract.
